something happened in the area that is "owned" by this extension.

Returns:
NOIR_SUCC if we handled and "swallowed" the event, NOIR_IGNORED otherwise
Parameters:
il - the icon-list where the event happened
i - the instance of this extension
x - mouse/x
y - mouse/y
b - mouse/button
t - event-type (see theme.h)
m - modifiers (see theme.h)
data - user-data (often the session)
rp - where the plugin can return a pointer
